info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Aggregation By Customer Id-spec
info.description: The Aggregation Management API enables businesses to manage customer-specific aggregation data efficiently. This endpoint allows for the removal of aggregation records associated with a particular customer, streamlining data management and ensuring compliance with data retention policies. It is particularly useful for developers building systems that require accurate and timely data updates, such as customer relationship management or analytics platforms. Typical consumers include backend developers and data managers who need to manipulate or clean up customer-related data.

delete.summary: Remove a customer by their unique identifier.
delete.description: This endpoint allows for the deletion of a customer from the database using their unique customer ID. Ensure that the customer ID is valid, as attempting to delete a non-existent customer will result in an error. Use this operation with caution, as it permanently removes customer data.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a specific customer identified by the ID CUST-100045. Ensure that the proper permissions are in place before executing this operation.

204.description: The customer resource was successfully deleted.
